name: paleo-marketplace
description: PALEO multi-vendor Ethiopian marketplace with escrow payments, Telegram auth, OCR verification and live courier tracking.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "API,BUYER,VENDOR,ADMIN,COURIER" -c "cyan,green,yellow,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:buyer" "npm run dev:vendor" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:courier"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@paleo/buyer-storefront && npm run build --workspace=@paleo/vendor-dashboard && npm run build --workspace=@paleo/admin-console && npm run build --workspace=@paleo/courier-web-view
